findings.title: OutOfStockError and ValidationError messages carry the raw, non-canonical SKU
findings.why: `reserve`, `release`, `ship` and `adjust` canonicalise the SKU for storage but pass the caller's spelling into `OutOfStockError(sku, …)` and the validation messages. `reserve(' mug-01', 99, …)` therefore reports `OutOfStockError.sku === ' mug-01'`. The catalogue's `InactiveProductError` uses the canonical SKU, and the new movement records and `lowStock` rows are canonical, so the error is the one place that still shows the raw spelling. I found this by reading the code.
